workarounds.symptom: FFMPEG_NULL_SINK_FALSE_PLAYABILITY: FFmpeg null-sink (-f null -) and single-frame extraction (-vframes 1) return exit code 0 on bit-corrupted MP4/H.264/HEVC files, causing agents to falsely declare unplayable, freezing, or truncated media as playable.
workarounds.workaround: Enforce 3-point verification: (1) assert decoded duration >= 80% of container header duration; (2) extract visual frames at 25%, 50%, and 75% intervals with color entropy verification; (3) explicitly disclose discarded frame counts and truncated durations when using -fflags +discardcorrupt.
